name: 10,000 Needles
doc: 10,000 Needles (the Jumbo Cactuar's attack; 1000 Needles' module at other addresses, later and bigger): the director and the needle task - needles flying from random points of the caster to random points of the target, a spark where each one arrives, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag178_10000_needles.cpp) run on the program's memory (its needle and spark tables, queues and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The timeline: the needles start at a tick with the sound, the damage (every target of the action) at a tick, the end

parts.title: Needles
parts.doc: Needles fly from random effect points of the caster to random ones of the target (both moved at random), a few steps each, a flat-shaded tetrahedron turned along its way and scaled at random

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: A spark sprite where each needle arrives, lifted by its table as its ticks run out

params.label: Needles tick
params.doc: The needles start at this tick of the director (with the sound)

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage (every target of the action) at this tick

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The director's last tick (the effect ends once every needle and spark has)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Last spawn tick
params.doc: Needles spawn from the needle task's tick 0 to this one

params.label: A tick
params.doc: How many spawn a tick (300 needles at most at once)

params.label: Steps
params.doc: A needle's flight in ticks: this + a random below the next

params.label: Spread
params.doc: Its start and its end each moved by a random below this on each axis, centred

params.label: Scale
params.doc: Its size: this + a random below the next (4096 = the model's own)

params.label: Needle vertices
params.doc: The needle's four vertices (x, y, z; it points along -z) (32 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Needle triangles
params.doc: The needle's four gouraud triangles: the first corner's colour and GPU code, three vertex numbers (x 2), the other two corners' colours (80 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Life
params.doc: A spark's ticks (its lift table holds 7 rows, read by the ticks left: 6 at most)

params.label: Size
params.doc: The spark sprite's scale (256 = the game's)

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 1 frame: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Spark lift
params.doc: The spark's screen y offset by its ticks left (rows 0..6; negative = up) (28 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)
